hooks.command: if [ ! -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/apps/web/.env" ]; then MAIN="$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" worktree list | head -1 | awk '{print $1}')"; if ! bash "$MAIN/scripts/setup-worktree.sh" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" > "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/setup-worktree.log" 2>&1; then tail -n 50 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/setup-worktree.log"; exit 2; fi; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Setting up worktree (pnpm install, Postgres, migrations)...

hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$FILE" == *.ts || "$FILE" == *.tsx ]]; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pnpm check 2>&1 | tail -20; fi; exit 0
